people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”
translations.bsb: Then Jesus declared, “For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind may see and those who see may become blind.”
translations.kjv: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
translations.asv: And Jesus said, For judgment came I into this world, that they that see not may see; and that they that see may become blind.
